args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and keep them until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast so error toasts use an assertive live region (`aria-live="assertive"`) and do not auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, requiring manual dismissal instead.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should be announced assertively via `aria-live="assertive"` rather than politely, and they should not automatically dismiss after five seconds so users have enough time to read and dismiss them.
